findings.title: Priority cast to 'low' is misleading
findings.why: `priority.trim().toLowerCase() as 'low'` forces an arbitrary string into the type of one valid value just to pass the compiler. `list.add` validates it at runtime, so the result is right. A cast to `Priority`, or a plain `string` field in `NewTask`, would say what is meant.

findings.title: Type re-export is separated from the other re-exports
findings.why: `export type { ImportReport, RejectedLine }` sits at the bottom of the file after the function. All the other re-exports are grouped at the top, next to the `importTasks` export they belong with.

findings.title: Title length counts UTF-16 units, not characters
findings.why: `validateTitle` and its doc comment speak of characters, but `trimmed.length` counts UTF-16 code units. A title with emoji or other astral characters is limited to fewer than 120 visible characters.
